panels.title: Observed active apartment sale listings
panels.description: Distinct article IDs in the fixed apartments + sale scope; active means last seen within 14 days and not closed.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT article_id)::int AS observed_active_listings FROM dashboard_public.current_listings WHERE deal = 'sale' AND category_memberships @> ARRAY['apartments']::text[]

panels.title: Valid asking KM/m²
panels.description: Median sale asking price per m². The sample count is returned beside the metric; insufficient data is NULL.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*)::int AS priced_sample, round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ppm2))::int AS median_asking_km_m2 FROM dashboard_public.current_listings WHERE deal = 'sale' AND category_memberships @> ARRAY['apartments']::text[] AND ppm2 > 0

panels.title: New active listings · 7 days
panels.description: First observed in the window, deduplicated by article ID; renewals are excluded.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT article_id)::int AS new_active_listings FROM dashboard_public.current_listings WHERE deal = 'sale' AND category_memberships @> ARRAY['apartments']::text[] AND first_seen >= now() - INTERVAL '7 days'

panels.title: Asking-price distribution by neighborhood
panels.description: Neighborhood aggregates use a minimum of ten eligible sale listings. (no pin) and (unmapped) are coverage categories, not neighborhoods.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT neighborhood, count(*)::int AS sample, round(percentile_cont(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ppm2))::int AS p25_km_m2, round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ppm2))::int AS median_km_m2, round(percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ppm2))::int AS p75_km_m2
FROM dashboard_public.current_listings
WHERE deal = 'sale' AND category_memberships @> ARRAY['apartments']::text[] AND ppm2 > 0
GROUP BY neighborhood HAVING count(*) >= 10 ORDER BY median_km_m2 DESC

panels.title: Lower asking price relative to comparable listings
panels.description: Candidates are compared only within neighborhood + room + area cohorts with at least ten other eligible listings. This is a relative asking-price signal, not fair value.

targets.rawSql:
WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT *, COALESCE(rooms, '(unknown)') AS room_key, width_bucket(COALESCE(sqm, 0), 0, 300, 6) AS area_band
  FROM dashboard_public.current_listings
  WHERE deal = 'sale' AND category_memberships @> ARRAY['apartments']::text[] AND ppm2 > 0
), cohorts AS (
  SELECT neighborhood, room_key, area_band, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ppm2) AS cohort_median, count(*) AS cohort_n
  FROM eligible GROUP BY neighborhood, room_key, area_band HAVING count(*) >= 11
)
SELECT e.title, e.url, e.neighborhood, e.rooms, e.sqm, e.ppm2, round(c.cohort_median)::int AS cohort_median_km_m2, (c.cohort_n - 1)::int AS other_listings
FROM eligible e JOIN cohorts c USING (neighborhood, room_key, area_band)
WHERE e.ppm2 < c.cohort_median ORDER BY e.ppm2 ASC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Recent reductions · currently observed
panels.description: Historical reduction event and current availability are shown separately; prices are asking prices.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT title, url, neighborhood, rooms, sqm, prior_price, new_price, reduction_km, reduction_pct, event_at, last_seen
FROM dashboard_public.price_reductions
WHERE deal = 'sale' AND category_memberships @> ARRAY['apartments']::text[] AND event_at >= now() - INTERVAL '7 days' AND currently_observed
ORDER BY event_at DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Daily asking-price trend
panels.description: Reconstructed daily apartment-sale inventory. Median and quartiles are asking prices, not transaction prices; missing days are not converted to zero.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo' AS time, round(percentile_cont(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ppm2))::int AS p25_km_m2, round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ppm2))::int AS median_km_m2, round(percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ppm2))::int AS p75_km_m2, count(*)::int AS priced_sample, bool_or(stale_observation) AS has_stale_observation, bool_or(provisional_day) AS provisional_day
FROM dashboard_public.daily_market
WHERE day >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - 30 AND day < (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date AND deal = 'sale' AND category_memberships @> ARRAY['apartments']::text[] AND price_state = 'valid' AND ppm2 > 0
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day
